Lulu|sup.identity: Protective enchanter. Pix, her faerie, follows a champion and fires projectiles when they attack (passive). Glitterlance (Q): Lulu and Pix each fire a bolt that damages and heavily slows, Whimsy (W) speeds up an ally (movement and attack speed) or turns an enemy into a critter that can't attack or cast, Help, Pix! (E) sends Pix to shield an ally or damage an enemy (and follow them), and Wild Growth (R) enlarges an ally: they gain a lot of health, knock up nearby enemies and slow those around them.
Lulu|sup.playstyle: Protection and poke support: she harasses with Pix and Q, then makes her carry nearly unkillable with W, E and R. Only one clearly unfavorable matchup (Sona), and she crushes divers she polymorphs (Camille, Pantheon, Swain).
Lulu|sup.early_game: Poke with E on your opponent, then Q: Pix also fires from where it is. Keep Whimsy (W) to polymorph an enemy engage or speed up your ADC during a trade. Your shield (E) on your ADC helps win trades or survive an engage.
Lulu|sup.level_1: Help, Pix! (E) first. After that, max E first, then W.
Lulu|sup.level_2: Glitterlance (Q). Combo: E on your opponent, Q from Lulu and Pix, guaranteed slow.
Lulu|sup.level_3: Whimsy (W). Polymorph an enemy engage, or speed up your ADC for an all-in.
Lulu|sup.level_6: Wild Growth: saves an ally in danger (bonus health) and knocks up divers around them. Cast it on the carry the enemy wants to kill.
power_spikes: Level 6: an ultimate that cancels a dive.
Teamfights: W, E and R on your best carry.
Lulu|sup.lane_plan: Harass with E + Q, protect your ADC and keep W against engages. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Lulu|sup.trading: Basic trade: E on your opponent, Q, attacks. All-in: W (speed) and E (shield) on your ADC. Defense: W on the enemy engage, R on the dived target. Back off against supports who poke harder (Sona): protect rather than trade.
threats: Thresh, your most common opponent, below your average on both sources.
Several divers at once: you can only polymorph one target.
mistakes: Using W to poke instead of keeping it against the engage.
Casting your ultimate too late, on an ally who's already dead.
Protecting a secondary ally instead of your best carry.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Polymorph him when he comes in with his hook, and E on the target he catches.
matchup_notes.Nami: Poke trades: shield your ADC when she casts Ebb and Flow.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: W to polymorph Nautilus as soon as his anchor lands.
matchup_notes.Milio: Two enchanters: the better poke wins, harass with E + Q.
matchup_notes.Sona: Her poke gets through your shields: stay behind minions.

Lulu|sup.mid_game: Stick with your strongest carry. Place Control Wards and harass before objectives.
Lulu|sup.late_game: Stay next to your best carry: W to speed them up, E to protect them, R when they're dived. Polymorph the enemy diver or assassin.
Lulu|sup.ahead: Harass harder and make your carry untouchable.
Lulu|sup.behind: Play protection: as long as your carry lives, they can turn the game around.
Lulu|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to keep your best carry alive and let them hit freely.
Lulu|sup.final_tip: Polymorphing the enemy diver is often worth more than all your shields: keep W for the moment they go in.
